rapport_notes: Warm and respectful when the customer ultimately declined (wanted load-only help, not a full move) — thanked her and left the door open.

evidence_quotes.agenda: what are your biggest concerns and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today? / Customer: 'I don't have the equipment...hard to get in and out of there.'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Rep answered with one reassurance (professionally trained, experienced with storage units) then moved into disassembly/logistics questions — no deeper follow-up on the access/equipment worry itself.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Our movers they are professionally trained and there are well experience[d] moving items from a storage unit (commit-to-rate/experience framing); no window/beats-it framing found in this transcript.

top_strength: Built a clear, itemized two-day cross-region moving plan (load day, overnight, unload day) that made a complex logistical scenario easy to follow before pricing it.
coaching_note: The customer's stated concern was specifically about equipment/access — a deeper follow-up ('is it the elevator, the boxes, or the whole trip that worries you?') could have surfaced that she only wanted loading help much earlier, before a full multi-day quote she wasn't going to buy.
